**The clinical or statistical use case**

What threshold-evaluation problem would this solve, and who needs it?

**Proposed API**

A short sketch of the method signature and what it would return.

**Reference**

Any paper or canonical implementation that defines the method. New statistical
methods must come with a reference (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Scope check**

oncothresh covers binary outcomes derived from continuous scores at clinical
thresholds. Survival endpoints and multi-class problems are out of scope. Does
your request fit?
